userSpecifiedSources: Baseball Savant leaderboards (MLB Advanced Media), https://baseballsavant.mlb.com/leaderboard/ : 18 tables for the 2024-2026 regular seasons, 16 through savant-extras 0.6.0 (https://pypi.org/project/savant-extras/) and outs_above_average / outfield_jump from Savant's CSV endpoints; regular-season dates from MLB StatsAPI. pitcher_quality: FanGraphs (https://www.fangraphs.com/), 2024-2025. Built by build.py in https://github.com/yasumorishima/kaggle-datasets (savant-extras-dataset), which publishes nothing unless every gate in the description passes.

arm_strength.csv.description: Fielder throw speed by position (Baseball Savant arm strength leaderboard), one row per fielder and season. primary_position is the scorer's position number (3 = 1B ... 9 = RF, 10 = DH; 2 and 11 also occur, with primary_position_name empty); primary_position_name spells it out.

columns.primary_position_name: Primary position name (e.g., Shortstop, Right Fielder).
columns.total_throws_lf: Total throws recorded from left field.
columns.total_throws_cf: Total throws recorded from center field.
columns.total_throws_rf: Total throws recorded from right field.
columns.total_throws_inf: Total throws recorded from infield positions.
columns.total_throws_of: Total throws recorded from outfield positions.
columns.arm_lf: Average throw velocity from left field (mph).
columns.arm_cf: Average throw velocity from center field (mph).
columns.arm_rf: Average throw velocity from right field (mph).
columns.arm_inf: Average throw velocity from infield positions (mph).
columns.arm_of: Average throw velocity from outfield positions (mph).
columns.arm_overall: Overall average throw velocity across all positions (mph).
columns.year: MLB regular season (2024, 2025 or 2026). Set from the request.

baserunning.csv.description: Baserunning run value (extra bases taken and stolen-base attempts) per runner and season.

columns.start_year: Start of the query period (season year).
columns.end_year: End of the query period (season year).
columns.runner_runs_tot: Total baserunning run value (runs above average).
columns.runner_runs_XB_swipe: Run value from taking extra bases aggressively.
columns.runner_runs_XB_snipe: Run value from reading the ball well and taking extra bases.
columns.runner_runs_XB_freeze: Run value lost from being held at a base.
columns.N_runner_moved_XB: Number of extra base advancement opportunities.
columns.runner_runs_SB2: Run value from stolen base attempts at 2nd base.
columns.runner_runs_SB3: Run value from stolen base attempts at 3rd base.
columns.simple_stolen_on_running_act_SB2: Simple stolen base run value at 2nd base.
columns.simple_stolen_on_running_act_SB3: Simple stolen base run value at 3rd base.
columns.year: MLB regular season (2024, 2025 or 2026). Set from the request.

basestealing.csv.description: Stolen base run value, attempts and lead distances per runner and season.

columns.start_year: Start of the query period (season year).
columns.end_year: End of the query period (season year).
columns.key_target_base: Target base for stolen base attempts (e.g., All, 2B, 3B).
columns.runs_stolen_on_running_act: Total run value from stolen base activity.
columns.n_init: Total number of stolen base opportunities.
columns.net_act_plus: Net run value from positive running actions.
columns.net_act_minus: Net run value from negative running actions.
columns.r_sec_minus_prim_lead: Difference between secondary and primary lead distance (feet).
columns.r_primary_lead_sbx: Average primary lead distance on stolen base attempts (feet).
columns.r_secondary_lead_sbx: Average secondary lead distance on stolen base attempts (feet).
columns.r_sec_minus_prim_lead_sbx: Lead distance difference on stolen base attempts (feet).
columns.year: MLB regular season (2024, 2025 or 2026). Set from the request.

bat_tracking.csv.description: Bat tracking per batter and regular season (bat speed, swing tilt, attack angle and direction, contact point), minimum 100 competitive swings. Dates are the regular season from MLB StatsAPI.

columns.name: Player full name (Last, First).
columns.swing_tilt: Tilt angle of the swing plane (degrees).
columns.attack_angle: Angle of the bat at contact relative to the pitch trajectory (degrees).
columns.attack_direction: Horizontal direction of the swing at contact (degrees). Positive = pull side.
columns.ideal_attack_angle_rate: Rate of swings within the ideal attack angle range (0-1).
columns.avg_intercept_y_vs_plate: Average vertical intercept distance relative to the plate (inches).
columns.avg_intercept_y_vs_batter: Average vertical intercept distance relative to the batter (inches).
columns.avg_batter_y_position: Average vertical position of the batter at contact (inches).
columns.avg_batter_x_position: Average horizontal position of the batter at contact (inches).
columns.year: MLB regular season (2024, 2025 or 2026). Set from the request.

batted_ball.csv.description: Batted-ball profile per qualified batter and season: ground/air/fly/line/pop rates and pull/straight/oppo splits.

columns.name: Player full name (Last, First).
columns.year: MLB regular season (2024, 2025 or 2026). Set from the request.
columns.gb_rate: Ground ball rate (proportion of batted balls that are ground balls).
columns.air_rate: Air ball rate (fly balls + line drives + pop-ups combined).
columns.fb_rate: Fly ball rate (proportion of batted balls that are fly balls).
columns.ld_rate: Line drive rate (proportion of batted balls that are line drives).
columns.pu_rate: Pop-up rate (proportion of batted balls that are pop-ups).
columns.pull_rate: Pull rate (proportion of batted balls hit to pull side).
columns.straight_rate: Straight-away rate (proportion of batted balls hit up the middle).
columns.oppo_rate: Opposite field rate (proportion of batted balls hit to opposite field).
columns.pull_gb_rate: Pull ground ball rate (proportion of ground balls hit to pull side).
columns.straight_gb_rate: Straight ground ball rate (proportion of ground balls hit up the middle).
columns.pull_air_rate: Pull air ball rate (proportion of air balls hit to pull side).

catcher_blocking.csv.description: Catcher blocking: blocks above average and passed balls/wild pitches against expected, by difficulty.

columns.start_year: Start of the query period (season year).
columns.end_year: End of the query period (season year).
columns.catcher_blocking_runs: Total blocking run value (runs above average).
columns.n_pbwp: Actual number of passed balls and wild pitches allowed.
columns.x_pbwp: Expected number of passed balls and wild pitches based on pitch difficulty.
columns.blocks_above_average_per_game: Blocks above average per game played.
columns.freq_pbwp_easy: Frequency of easy blocking chances (proportion of total pitches).
columns.diff_pbwp_easy: Run value difference on easy blocking chances.
columns.diff_pbwp_medium: Run value difference on medium-difficulty blocking chances.
columns.diff_pbwp_tough: Run value difference on tough blocking chances.
columns.year: MLB regular season (2024, 2025 or 2026). Set from the request.

catcher_stance.csv.description: Catcher stance, one row per catcher and season: how often each setup is used and the framing, blocking and throwing value from one-knee and other stances.

columns.name: Catcher name.
columns.year: MLB regular season (2024, 2025 or 2026). Set from the request.
columns.knee_down_pct: Proportion of pitches caught in one-knee-down stance.
columns.l_down_r_up_pct: Proportion with left knee down, right knee up.
columns.r_down_l_up_pct: Proportion with right knee down, left knee up.
columns.both_up_pct: Proportion with both knees up (traditional stance).
columns.one_knee_framing_rv: Framing run value for one-knee stance.
columns.other_framing_rv: Framing run value for traditional (non-one-knee) stance.
columns.one_knee_calledstr_pct: Called strike percentage in one-knee stance.
columns.other_calledstr_pct: Called strike percentage in traditional stance.
columns.one_knee_blocking_rv: Blocking run value for one-knee stance.
columns.other_blocking_rv: Blocking run value for traditional stance.
columns.one_knee_pbwp100: Passed balls and wild pitches per 100 pitches in one-knee stance.
columns.other_pbwp100: Passed balls and wild pitches per 100 pitches in traditional stance.
columns.one_knee_throwing_rv: Throwing run value for one-knee stance.
columns.other_throwing_rv: Throwing run value for traditional stance.
columns.one_knee_csaa100: Caught stealing above average per 100 attempts in one-knee stance.
columns.other_csaa100: Caught stealing above average per 100 attempts in traditional stance.
columns.one_knee_pitching_rv: Overall pitching run value for one-knee stance.
columns.other_pitching_rv: Overall pitching run value for traditional stance.

catcher_throwing.csv.description: Catcher throwing: pop time, exchange, arm strength and caught stealing above average.

columns.start_year: Start of the query period (season year).
columns.end_year: End of the query period (season year).
columns.sb_attempts: Total stolen base attempts against the catcher.
columns.catcher_stealing_runs: Total throwing run value (runs above average on stolen base attempts).
columns.est_cs_pct: Expected caught stealing percentage based on pop time and runner speed.
columns.cs_aa_per_throw: Caught stealing above average per throw.
columns.seasonal_runner_speed: Average sprint speed of runners attempting to steal (ft/sec).
columns.runner_distance_from_second: Average runner distance from 2nd base at pitch release (feet).
columns.pop_time: Average pop time from catch to throw reaching 2nd base (seconds).
columns.exchange_time: Average exchange time from catch to release (seconds).
columns.n_xcs_with_flight_over_xcs: Number of expected CS where throw flight time exceeded average.
columns.n_xcs_with_exchange_over_xcs: Number of expected CS where exchange time exceeded average.
columns.n_xcs_with_accuracy_over_xcs: Number of expected CS where accuracy was above average.
columns.n_xcs_with_ground_other_over_xcs: Number of expected CS with ground ball or other outcome.
columns.n_xcs_with_onfly_other_over_xcs: Number of expected CS with on-fly other outcome.
columns.n_xcs_with_untracked_other_over_xcs: Number of expected CS with untracked outcome.
columns.year: MLB regular season (2024, 2025 or 2026). Set from the request.

home_runs.csv.description: Home runs per batter and season with park-adjusted expected HR, no-doubters, mostly-gone and doubters, and trot time. Baseball Savant's home run leaderboard has no season-type filter and counts postseason home runs: 2024 and 2025 include their postseason, 2026 includes postseason games played up to the build date (the 2026 postseason began 2026-09-29).

columns.year: MLB regular season (2024, 2025 or 2026). Set from the request.
columns.type: HR classification type used (e.g., adj_xhr = adjusted expected home runs).
columns.avg_hr_trot: Average home run trot time (seconds from contact to home plate).
columns.doubters: Number of home runs that were in doubt (not clearly going out).
columns.mostly_gone: Number of home runs that were mostly certain to be home runs.
columns.no_doubters: Number of no-doubt home runs (clearly over the fence by a large margin).
columns.no_doubter_per: Percentage of home runs that were no-doubters.
columns.xhr: Expected home runs based on exit velocity, launch angle, and spray angle.
columns.xhr_diff: Difference between actual HR total and expected HR total (hr_total - xhr).

outfield_jump.csv.description: Outfielder jump on 2-star-and-harder plays (qualified outfielders): reaction, burst and route against league average, fetched from Baseball Savant's CSV endpoint.

columns.resp_fielder_id: MLB Advanced Media (MLBAM) player id of the outfielder.
columns.year: MLB regular season (2024, 2025 or 2026). Set from the request.
columns.outs_above_average: Outs above average on the 2-star-and-harder plays this leaderboard covers.
columns.outs_per_play: Outs made per 100 opportunities (percent) on those plays.
columns.rel_league_burst_distance: Feet covered vs league average in any direction from 1.5 to 3.0 seconds (burst).
columns.rel_league_reaction_distance: Feet covered vs league average in any direction in the first 1.5 seconds (reaction).
columns.rel_league_routing_distance: Feet vs league average gained or lost by direction: feet covered in the right direction relative to feet covered in any direction over the first 3 seconds (route). Reaction + burst + route = rel_league_bootup_distance.
columns.rel_league_bootup_distance: Total jump vs league average: feet covered in the right direction in the first 3 seconds (reaction + burst + route).
columns.f_bootup_distance: Feet covered in the right direction in the first 3 seconds (the jump).

outs_above_average.csv.description: Outs above average and fielding runs prevented per qualified fielder and season, with directional and batter-hand splits, fetched from Baseball Savant's CSV endpoint.

columns.display_team_name: Team (the last one when the player moved).
columns.year: MLB regular season (2024, 2025 or 2026). Set from the request.
columns.fielding_runs_prevented: Fielding runs prevented (OAA converted to runs).
columns.outs_above_average: Outs above average: outs made compared with an average fielder given each ball's catch probability.
columns.outs_above_average_infront: OAA on balls hit in front of the fielder (coming in).
columns.outs_above_average_lateral_toward3bline: OAA on balls requiring movement toward the third-base line.
columns.outs_above_average_lateral_toward1bline: OAA on balls requiring movement toward the first-base line.
columns.outs_above_average_behind: OAA on balls hit behind the fielder (going back).
columns.actual_success_rate_formatted: Share of opportunities converted to outs (percent).
columns.adj_estimated_success_rate_formatted: Expected success rate for an average fielder on the same opportunities (percent).
columns.diff_success_rate_formatted: Actual minus expected success rate (percentage points).

park_factors.csv.description: Statcast park factors by club and season from Baseball Savant: runs over 1-year and 3-year windows, and HR, 1B/2B/3B, SO, BB, OBP, wOBA, contact-quality and hard-hit factors (100 = neutral).

columns.team: Club abbreviation (OAK is the Athletics, also for Sutter Health Park from 2025).
columns.venue_id: MLB venue id of the home park.
columns.pf_3yr: Runs park factor, 3-year rolling window (100 = neutral). Empty when the park has no 3-year history (the Athletics' Sutter Health Park in 2025 and 2026, the Rays' George M. Steinbrenner Field in 2025); so are the other 3-year columns.
columns.pf_hr: Home run park factor, 3-year window (100 = neutral).
columns.pf_wobacon: wOBA on contact park factor, 3-year window.
columns.pf_xwobacon: Expected wOBA on contact park factor, 3-year window.
columns.pf_bacon: Batting average on contact park factor, 3-year window.
columns.pf_xbacon: Expected batting average on contact park factor, 3-year window.
columns.pf_hardhit: Hard-hit rate (95+ mph exit velocity) park factor, 3-year window.
columns.pf_wobatto: wOBA park factor on batted balls and strikeouts/walks (Savant's wobatto), 3-year window.
columns.year: MLB regular season (2024, 2025 or 2026). Set from the request.

pitch_movement.csv.description: Pitch movement per pitcher, pitch type and season, against league average for the same pitch type. Every pitch type Savant serves (one request per type and season).

columns.year: MLB regular season (2024, 2025 or 2026). Set from the request.
columns.pitch_hand: Pitcher throwing hand (R = Right, L = Left).
columns.pitches_thrown: Number of times this pitch type was thrown.
columns.total_pitches: Total pitches thrown by the pitcher (all pitch types).
columns.pitch_per: Usage rate of this pitch type (proportion of total pitches).
columns.pitch_type: Pitch type code (e.g., FF = 4-Seam Fastball, SL = Slider).
columns.pitcher_break_z: Pitcher's vertical break for this pitch (inches, gravity-adjusted).
columns.league_break_z: League average vertical break for this pitch type (inches).
columns.diff_z: Difference from league average vertical break (pitcher_break_z - league_break_z).
columns.rise: Rise (positive vertical break) value for this pitch (inches).
columns.pitcher_break_z_induced: Induced vertical break (spin-driven only, gravity removed) for this pitch (inches).
columns.pitcher_break_x: Pitcher's horizontal break for this pitch (inches).
columns.league_break_x: League average horizontal break for this pitch type (inches).
columns.diff_x: Difference from league average horizontal break (pitcher_break_x - league_break_x).
columns.tail: Horizontal tail (arm-side run) value for this pitch (inches).
columns.percent_rank_diff_z: Percentile rank for vertical break difference vs. league average.
columns.percent_rank_diff_x: Percentile rank for horizontal break difference vs. league average.

pitch_tempo.csv.description: Pitch tempo per pitcher and season: median seconds between pitches with the bases empty, pitch counts with bases empty and with runners on, and the share of hot/warm/cold tempo pitches. Savant's CSV export repeats the bases-empty median (and total_pitches) where the runners-on median should be; the copies are dropped.

columns.total_pitches_empty: Total pitches thrown with bases empty.
columns.median_seconds_empty: Median seconds between pitches with bases empty.
columns.total_pitches_onbase: Total pitches thrown with runners on base.
columns.freq_hot: Proportion of pitches thrown at a fast pace (hot tempo).
columns.freq_warm: Proportion of pitches thrown at a moderate pace (warm tempo).
columns.freq_cold: Proportion of pitches thrown at a slow pace (cold tempo).
columns.year: MLB regular season (2024, 2025 or 2026). Set from the request.

pitcher_arm_angle.csv.description: Pitcher arm angle and release/shoulder position per pitcher and season.

columns.pitch_hand: Pitcher throwing hand (R = Right, L = Left).
columns.ball_angle: Arm angle at release point (degrees). 0 = sidearm, 90 = overhand.
columns.relative_release_ball_x: Horizontal release position relative to pitcher's body (feet).
columns.release_ball_z: Vertical release height from the ground (feet).
columns.relative_shoulder_x: Horizontal shoulder position relative to the rubber (feet).
columns.year: MLB regular season (2024, 2025 or 2026). Set from the request.

pitcher_quality.csv.description: FanGraphs Stuff+, Location+ and Pitching+ per pitcher, 2024 and 2025 only (carried over from the previous version; FanGraphs does not serve the build machine).

columns.name: Pitcher name.
columns.team: Team (FanGraphs abbreviation; '- - -' for players on several teams).
columns.stuff_plus: Stuff+ (FanGraphs): quality of pitch characteristics, 100 = MLB average.
columns.location_plus: Location+ (FanGraphs): command of pitch location, 100 = MLB average.
columns.pitching_plus: Pitching+ (FanGraphs): Stuff+ and Location+ combined, 100 = MLB average.
columns.season: MLB season (2024 or 2025; FanGraphs is not reachable from the build machine, so 2026 is not included).

running_game.csv.description: Pitchers' control of the running game: runs prevented, stolen base attempts, pickoffs and leads allowed.

columns.start_year: Start of the query period (season year).
columns.end_year: End of the query period (season year).
columns.key_target_base: Target base for stolen base attempts tracked (e.g., All, 2B, 3B).
columns.runs_prevented_on_running_attr: Total runs prevented on running attributes by the pitcher.
columns.n_pitcher_cs_aa: Pitcher's caught stealing above average count.
columns.n_init: Total number of stolen base opportunities faced.
columns.rate_sbx: Stolen base attempt rate against this pitcher.
columns.n_sb: Number of successful stolen bases allowed.
columns.n_pk: Number of pickoffs by the pitcher.
columns.n_bk: Number of balks by the pitcher.
columns.n_fb: Number of first-pitch breaks (early jumps by runners).
columns.n_plus: Number of positive outcomes (pitcher prevented a stolen base).
columns.n_minus: Number of negative outcomes (stolen base allowed).
columns.net_attr_plus: Net run value from positive pitching-side running game outcomes.
columns.net_attr_minus: Net run value from negative pitching-side running game outcomes.
columns.r_primary_lead: Average primary lead distance allowed by the pitcher (feet).
columns.r_sec_minus_prim_lead: Difference between secondary and primary lead allowed (feet).
columns.r_primary_lead_sbx: Average primary lead on stolen base attempts (feet).
columns.r_secondary_lead_sbx: Average secondary lead on stolen base attempts (feet).
columns.r_sec_minus_prim_lead_sbx: Lead distance difference on stolen base attempts (feet).
columns.year: MLB regular season (2024, 2025 or 2026). Set from the request.

swing_take.csv.description: Swing/take run value by attack zone (Heart, Shadow, Chase, Waste). Baseball Savant's default list: the 300 batters who saw the most pitches in the season.

columns.year: MLB regular season (2024, 2025 or 2026). Set from the request.
columns.runs_heart: Run value on pitches in the Heart of the zone.
columns.runs_shadow: Run value on pitches in the Shadow (edges) of the zone.
columns.runs_chase: Run value on pitches in the Chase region just outside the zone.
columns.runs_waste: Run value on pitches in the Waste region far outside the zone.

timer_infractions.csv.description: Pitch clock violations per team and season, by type.

columns.year: MLB regular season (2024, 2025 or 2026). Set from the request.
columns.pitches: Total pitches thrown by the team.
columns.all_violations: Total pitch clock violations (all types combined).
columns.pitcher_timer: Number of pitcher pitch clock violations.
columns.batter_timer: Number of batter pitch clock violations.
columns.catcher_timer: Number of catcher pitch clock violations.

year_to_year.csv.description: xwOBA for every season 2015-2026 with year-over-year changes, for the batters qualified in the season in `year` (2024 or 2025; Savant lists no one for 2026).

columns.name: Player full name (Last, First).
columns.2015: xwOBA for the 2015 season (empty if player was not active).
columns.2020: xwOBA for the 2020 season (60-game COVID season).
columns.year: Season whose qualified batters are listed (2024 or 2025).
